title: Chivimbo Chekutanga Chakaputswa muParadhiso
intro: Fungidzira wakamira mubindu rine rugare rwakakwana, uchikudzwa kupfuura zvisikwa zvose, uine muganhu mumwe chete wekuremekedza. Kuzevezera kunovimbisa kusingaperi, sarudzo imwe chete inoshandura zvese, asi tsitsi dzinovhura nzira yekudzoka. Ndiani anotaura kubva pakutanga kwevanhu?
clues: Ndakasikwa naAllah kubva muvhu uye ndakagadzirwa nehanya yaMwari.
Ndakakudzwa apo Allah akarayira ngirozi kuti dzindipfugamire.
Ndakagara muParadhiso nemukadzi wangu, ndakasununguka kunakidzwa nezvose kunze kwemuti mumwe chete.
Ndakanyengerwa nekuzevezera kwaSatani uyo akapika kuti ndiye mupi wezano wechokwadi.
Ndakadya kubva pamuti wairambidzwa uye chifukidziro changu chakabviswa nenyadzi.
Ndakadzidza mashoko ekupfidza kubva kuna Ishe wangu, uye Allah akanditendeukira netsitsi.

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Ndakanyura mumafashamo makuru pamwe chete nevasingatendi
Allah vakandidzidzisa mazwi ekupfidza uye vakandiregerera
Ndakarohwa nemheni nekuda kwekuda kuona Allah
Ndakamedzwa nehove huru nekuda kwekubva ndakatsamwa
Ndakashanduka nevanhu vangu nekuda kwekutyora Sabata
outcome.answer: Allah vakandidzidzisa mazwi ekupfidza uye vakandiregerera

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
